name: Alaska

retake.retakeFee: Confirm any additional test fee with the DMV

gdl.supervisedHoursRequired: 40 hours (10 at night or in inclement/hazardous conditions)
gdl.nightCurfew: Provisional drivers may not drive 1 a.m.-5 a.m. unless accompanied by a qualified licensed adult 21+ or traveling directly to or from employment
gdl.passengerLimits: No passengers under 21 except siblings, unless accompanied by a qualified licensed adult 21+ or traveling directly to or from employment

requiredDocuments: Proof of legal name, date of birth and lawful presence (certified birth certificate or valid U.S. passport)
process.realIdNotes: A REAL ID requires one document proving identity/date of birth/lawful presence, proof of Social Security number, and two proofs of Alaska residency. The REAL ID version of a license costs more than the standard credential.
process.visionStandard: At least 20/40 in one eye, with or without corrective lenses

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: 12 points in 12 months or 18 points in 24 months
facts.moveOverRule: Move over a lane or slow down for stopped emergency, law-enforcement and other authorized vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: Obey the posted school-zone limit when children are present

verifyNote: Official Alaska sources confirm the 20-question/16-correct exam, permit age 14, permit and license fees, BAC limits, and 12-points-in-12-months/18-points-in-24-months suspension thresholds. The manual does not print an edition year, so 2023 remains a placeholder; provisional restrictions and the full-license age still need direct official confirmation.
